event_study.signal_cutoff: article publication timestamp/date at or before analysis_date
event_study.entry: next actual trading-day open after each article date
event_study.deduplication: confidence-weighted collapse by ticker and article date
event_study.transaction_costs: not applicable to single-event label direction; required for portfolio backtest

semantic_gold_set.sampling: stratified with at least 30 predicted positive, 30 neutral, and 30 negative articles
semantic_gold_set.reviewer: independent human reviewer blinded to predicted label and future return

decision_rule: accuracy_validated may become true only after both semantic gold-set criteria and frozen future event-study criteria pass without changing labels, thresholds, sample, or horizons
